UNDER THE HOOD

Structural, transparent, deterministic.

Each turn identifies up to four of the strongest available directed routes. A Cut removes all incoming and outgoing contributions permanently. A Jam masks one node for the next propagation step. Route capacity is recomputed after every intervention.

PRECISION = TARGET SUPPRESSION × PROTECTED PRESERVATION

This demo uses a curated, biologically inspired circuit artifact for reliable gameplay. The production data pipeline is designed to substitute verified neuron-type connectivity without changing the game engine.
THE FRUIT-FLY CONNECTION

A huge brain in a tiny package.

A connectome is a wiring map of neurons and their connections. FlyBreak turns a small directed, weighted circuit into a strategy puzzle: nodes stand for aggregated neuron groups, lines represent structural connections, and line strength influences route capacity.

CURRENT DEMO: CURATED GAMEPLAY CIRCUIT
FINAL LEVEL: VERIFIED CONNECTOME-DERIVED CIRCUIT

Names such as “Grand Central” and the courier flies are game language, not official neuron annotations. The model explores structural influence; it does not simulate a living fly or prove behaviour.
